title: Vampire Vape Nicit Up 70/30 Nic Shot 10ml 18mg
description: Nicit Up are a line of Nicotine Shots from UK Vape brand Vampire Vape. NicIt Up nic shots let you tailor the nicotine content of your favourite 50ml and 100ml 0mg shortfill e-liquids so you can enjoy just the right amount of nicotine satisfaction in a long-lasting bottle of e-liquid. They come in a variety of PG/VG ratios and include Nicotine Salt formulations. Adding this 18mg nic shot to a 50ml bottle of 0mg e-liquid will produce 60ml of 3mg strength e-liquid.
